name: dtx-desktop
description: An Electron application with Svelte and TypeScript
author: example.com

scripts.check:entitlements: bun -e "const app = await Bun.file('build/entitlements.mac.plist').text(); const inherit = await Bun.file('build/entitlements.mac.inherit.plist').text(); if (app !== inherit) { console.error('macOS entitlements files are out of sync'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:node && bun run svelte-check
scripts.build:unpack: bun run check:entitlements && bun run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: bun run check:entitlements && bun run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: bun run check:entitlements && bun run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: bun run check:entitlements && bun run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.lint:codegen: bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code src/main/graphql/generated/
